Home / Service Area / Marietta

Vending Machines in Marietta, Georgia

If your building doesn't already have food service on site, you're not alone — most of Marietta's office parks, industrial buildings and the Wellstar Kennestone hospital campus don't either. Marietta's resident population is about 63,000, but its daytime population swells by an estimated 85.5% as workers commute in — the largest daytime-population swing of any city in the Cobb/Cherokee area we cover. Sidecar Vending Services installs and maintains snack and beverage machines across Marietta and East Cobb at no cost to the property. We're based in Sandy Springs, 24 minutes away off-peak, so a service call doesn't wait on a truck crossing the whole county.

Why Marietta Businesses Work With Sidecar

We prospect by park, not by zip code.

🗺️

We Know Where the Buildings Are

When we talk with you, we're talking about your actual building, not a generic city pitch. Marietta's own map of office and business parks names roughly two dozen distinct properties — Northchase Office Park, Franklin Oaks, Cobb Corporate Center, Northwest Business Center, Marble Mill Industrial, Delk Industrial, Allgood Industrial, the Northgate Distribution Center and more — and we start there.

🛣️

Close Enough to Actually Show Up

Our base in Sandy Springs is 14.6 road miles from Marietta Square, about 24 minutes off-peak via I-285 West and I-75 North. We route Marietta in three loops — East Cobb, west and south Marietta, and the Powers Ferry/Delk corridor — so your service call doesn't wait for one truck to cross the whole county.

💲

No Cost to the Property

Installation, stocking, servicing and repairs are ours to cover. You provide the floor space and a standard outlet — there's no purchase, no lease and no monthly fee to the property. If a placement underperforms, we change the mix or remove the machine.

Where We Fit Best

A hospital campus, a truck route, and a soft office market.

⚕️

Medical & Healthcare

If you're on a 24-hour clinical schedule, we build the machine around that: overnight caffeine, real food rather than only candy, and a nutrition-forward line for staff on rotating shifts. The Wellstar Kennestone Regional Medical Center campus on Church Street is a multi-tower acute-care facility, and its new nine-story, 235-bed Yellow Tower is scheduled to open April 15, 2026. Marietta zones the surrounding area as a Health Services district, and medical offices, dialysis centers and hospice facilities cluster on Kennestone Circle, Roswell Street, Windy Hill Road, Bells Ferry Road and Newmarket Parkway.

📦

Warehouses & Industrial

If you run a shift operation, an empty machine by second shift is a service failure we plan around. Marietta has a dedicated Office/Warehouse district and a dedicated Industrial district in its comprehensive plan, plus named parks including Marble Mill Industrial, Franklin Forest Industrial, Cumberland Point Industrial, Allgood Industrial, Delk Industrial, the Marietta-Cobb Industrial Parks East and West, West Side Industrial Park and the Northgate Distribution Center. We stock larger portions, energy and sports drinks, meat snacks and hot-beverage support, and set restock frequency to match.

🏢

Offices & Coworking

If you're leasing office space here, a stocked machine is something your leasing agent can point to on a tour. The Northwest Atlanta office submarket that contains Marietta held roughly 29.2 million square feet at 18.7% vacancy and $29.45 per square foot in early 2026. Because Marietta's office stock is suburban park product occupied largely by smaller tenants, we usually recommend combination snack-and-drink units over separate towers.

If you're an apartment community or auto dealership, we serve you too — these are secondary opportunities here rather than the primary market. Marietta has designated four higher-density redevelopment corridors — Franklin Gateway, City Center South Renaissance, the South Marietta Parkway Activity Center and the Delk Road transit-oriented district — and seven franchise dealership brands are present in the city, mostly worked lot by lot rather than as one corridor.

Coverage

Where we serve in Marietta and East Cobb.

Wherever you are in Marietta or East Cobb, there's a good chance we already cover it. We serve zip codes 30008, 30060, 30062, 30064, 30066, 30067 and 30068, including Marietta Square and the downtown CBD, the Franklin Gateway corridor, West Marietta and the Kennesaw Mountain area, and the Sandy Plains corridor in northeast Cobb. East Cobb neighborhoods in our service area include Indian Hills, Paper Mill, East Cobb Park, Highland Pointe, Highland Ridge, Northampton, Windsor Oaks, Chimney Springs, Chestnut Creek and the Atlanta Country Club area. Zip 30067 is shared with our Smyrna coverage along the Powers Ferry/Delk Road corridor, and we cover that corridor near Vinings too, where our Smyrna page carries most of the Vinings-Cumberland detail.

Common Questions

Marietta vending, answered.

Do you serve East Cobb as well as Marietta proper?

Yes. East Cobb zip codes 30062, 30066 and 30068 are all within our Marietta service area, and we run East Cobb as its own service loop separate from west and south Marietta. That includes the Indian Hills, Paper Mill, East Cobb Park, Highland Pointe, Northampton, Windsor Oaks and Atlanta Country Club areas, along with the Sandy Plains corridor.

How fast can you get to Marietta from your base?

Our base is in Sandy Springs, 14.6 road miles from Marietta Square — about 24 minutes off-peak via I-285 West and I-75 North. That's a free-flow estimate, not a rush-hour time; the I-285 West to I-75 North movement is slow at peak, which is why we schedule Marietta service mid-morning or early afternoon rather than at 5pm.

Can you service a building that runs more than one shift?

Yes, and Marietta has a lot of them. The city zones dedicated Office/Warehouse and Industrial districts and contains named distribution and industrial parks, while the Kennestone hospital campus runs around the clock. For multi-shift sites we change the product mix — larger portions, energy and sports drinks, meat snacks, hot beverage support — and raise restock frequency so second and third shift aren't working an empty machine.

Which Marietta zip codes do you cover?

30008, 30060, 30062, 30064, 30066, 30067 and 30068. That spans the Marietta CBD and Square, Franklin Gateway, the Powers Ferry/Delk Road corridor, West Marietta and Kennesaw Mountain, northeast Cobb along Sandy Plains, and all of East Cobb.

Do you place machines in medical offices, not just hospitals?

Yes. Marietta's medical uses extend well past the main hospital campus into freestanding buildings on Kennestone Circle, Roswell Street, Cobb Parkway North, Windy Hill Road, Powers Ferry Road, Newmarket Parkway, Village Parkway and Bells Ferry Road. A smaller medical office building is often a faster install for you than a hospital campus, since access and approvals are simpler.

What does a vending machine cost our property?

Nothing. Sidecar owns the equipment and covers installation, product, restocking, cash and card handling, and repairs. You provide floor space of roughly the footprint of a filing cabinet and a standard electrical outlet — no purchase price, no lease and no monthly fee.
